final: SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_home_games, SUM(games) / (SELECT SUM(games) FROM home_game) AS fraction_of_all, SUM(games) / (SELECT AVG(team_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(games) AS team_total FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id)) AS ratio_to_average FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
